item.title: Docs: port of ezzz's Swift layer vs UX evolutions, M5 proposal, UX decisions (H.1–H.3)
item.body:
## Issue
Refs #368 (directive H.1–H.3), Refs #379 (M5 proposal)
Claim: cloud/ui-convergence

## What and why
**Problem.** Directive H asks to separate two kinds of UI change:
- (a) **porting ezzz's legacy Swift layer**: the same UX, technical changes only;
- (b) **UX evolutions**.

So far the specs mixed both. Some (b) items already ship by default in merged code: Catégories sections, the topic row, the message header, the page bar, the tab bar kept in the reader, and the composer swipe-down.

**Changes.**
- `docs/migration/GAP-LEGACY-VS-SWIFT.md`:
  - an **H.1 column** on all 155 rows (`a`, `a·master`, `b·needed`, `b·operator`, `b`, `—`);
  - a **Convergence classification** section: the 109 classified GAP rows, the 80 app lots (33 a / 25 mixed / 22 b) and the features.
- `docs/migration/UX-DECISIONS-PENDING.md` (**new, temporary**): 25 decisions `UXD-01..25`, grouped by screen. Each gives option A (legacy), option B (proposed), a recommendation and its impact on M1–M4. The file is deleted once the decisions are recorded.
- **M5 · UX evolutions as a proposal only**:
  - a ROADMAP row, a README note, the board issue #379 (`status: blocked` until the contributors agree);
  - a `LOTS.md` section with the proposed whole-lot moves and 9 splits (`085b`…`134b`). Its rows do not start with `| LOT-`, so `lots_from_md.py` ignores them. **No lot changes milestone.**
- `LOTS.md` Audit cells: 5 "legacy parity" lots without a source at `2440d79` are relabelled (LOT-100, 101, 146; partly 108 and 127). `tooling/roadmap/lots.json` is regenerated, and only those 5 cells change.
- **H.2 rule**: AGENTS.md §4 adds a paragraph on `// Port of …` comments; `docs/lots/TEMPLATE.md` adds "Legacy counterpart" and "UX evolutions" sections and the App / HFRClient modules. The comments themselves are applied in #378.
- **Specs** LOT-081, 082, 083, 084, 119 and 170: a "UX evolutions (H.1)" section names each (b) item and its UXD id.
- `FEATURES.md`: one paragraph on the classification. Statuses are unchanged.

**Why this wide and no wider:** the directive asks for docs and specs only. No lot moves, nothing is deleted from scope, and no code changes.

**Method.** Four Sonnet agents classified by screen, reading the legacy symbols at `2440d79`. Opus consolidated, checked the disagreements and wrote the docs.

## How it was verified
- `python3 scripts/check-lot-deps.py`: 153 lots, 0 violations.
- `python3 -m unittest discover scripts/tests`: OK.
- `markdownlint-cli2`: 0 errors.
- Classification counts are checked by a script: every GAP row of the three types is classified once, and every app lot once (80).
- Adversarial review by a non-Opus model: see the comments.

## Checklist (AGENTS.md §9)
- [x] Docs only (+ the regenerated `lots.json`)
- [x] No secrets
- [ ] Author model: Opus / Reviewer model: Sonnet

6. GAP-116 cites its ObjC source. GAP-093 is now `b`, consistent with UXD-01.

8. UXD-15 and UXD-24 now say they are exceptions to "defaults keep the legacy UX".

+  - `a·master`: a port of ezzz's later Swift layer on `master`, absent at `2440d79` (UXD-01).
+  - `b`: a UX evolution, proposed for M5 ([#379](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/379)) unless a pending decision keeps it.
+  - `b·needed`: an evolution that parity needs (security, privacy, App Review, an HFR fact).
+  - `b·operator`: an evolution the operator already decided.
+  - `—`: not planned or dropped.
+  - The open choices are in [UX-DECISIONS-PENDING.md](UX-DECISIONS-PENDING.md).
 - Row ids `GAP-NNN` are stable: a later revision edits a row in place or appends a new id, never renumbers. Rows were extracted per area by Sonnet sub-agents and merged; duplicates across areas keep one row. A second Sonnet agent checked a sample of 20 legacy citations: 10 exact, 9 imprecise ranges and 1 wrong (all 10 corrected). Expect line ranges elsewhere to be approximate: check a ref before quoting it in a spec.

 - **SwiftHFR final** = `docs/LOTS.md` scope, the lot spec under `docs/lots/` when it exists, the lot issue otherwise, and [FEATURES.md](../FEATURES.md) with its UX principles. Not the current `App/` code.
 - **Gap**: `same` · `ported with changes` (same feature, different details, no visible UX change) · `UX change` (user-visible difference) · `new` (not in legacy) · `dropped` (removed on purpose by a spec) · `not planned` (legacy feature no lot covers).
 - **Source**: `port: ezzz Swift layer` (the behaviour comes from `HFRswift/Swift`) · `port: legacy ObjC` · `new UX: operator` · `new UX: Bybifok (FEAT-xxx)` · `new UX: spec` (a lot spec decided it) · `—` (not planned).
+- **H.1** (convergence classification, directive H.1):
+  - `a`: a port of ezzz's Swift layer at `2440d79`, or of the ObjC app where the Swift layer had nothing. Technical changes only (new engine, iOS 27 APIs, robustness, added themes with unchanged defaults).
+  - `a·master`: a port of ezzz's later Swift layer on `master`, absent at `2440d79` (UXD-01).
+  - `b`: a UX evolution, proposed for M5 ([#379](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/379)) unless a pending decision keeps it.
+  - `b·needed`: an evolution that parity needs (security, privacy, App Review, an HFR fact).
+  - `b·operator`: an evolution the operator already decided.
+  - `—`: not planned or dropped.
+  - The open choices are in [UX-DECISIONS-PENDING.md](UX-DECISIONS-PENDING.md).
 - Row ids `GAP-NNN` are stable: a later revision edits a row in place or appends a new id, never renumbers. Rows were extracted per area by Sonnet sub-agents and merged; duplicates across areas keep one row. A second Sonnet agent checked a sample of 20 legacy citations: 10 exact, 9 imprecise ranges and 1 wrong (all 10 corrected). Expect line ranges elsewhere to be approximate: check a ref before quoting it in a spec.

+- **H.1** (convergence classification, directive H.1):
+  - `a`: a port of ezzz's Swift layer at `2440d79`, or of the ObjC app where the Swift layer had nothing. Technical changes only (new engine, iOS 27 APIs, robustness, added themes with unchanged defaults).
+  - `a·master`: a port of ezzz's later Swift layer on `master`, absent at `2440d79` (UXD-01).
+  - `b`: a UX evolution, proposed for M5 ([#379](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/379)) unless a pending decision keeps it.
+  - `b·needed`: an evolution that parity needs (security, privacy, App Review, an HFR fact).
+  - `b·operator`: an evolution the operator already decided.
+  - `—`: not planned or dropped.
+  - The open choices are in [UX-DECISIONS-PENDING.md](UX-DECISIONS-PENDING.md).
 - Row ids `GAP-NNN` are stable: a later revision edits a row in place or appends a new id, never renumbers. Rows were extracted per area by Sonnet sub-agents and merged; duplicates across areas keep one row. A second Sonnet agent checked a sample of 20 legacy citations: 10 exact, 9 imprecise ranges and 1 wrong (all 10 corrected).  - **SwiftHFR final** = `docs/LOTS.md` scope, the lot spec under `docs/lots/` when it exists, the lot issue otherwise, and [FEATURES.md](../FEATURES.md) with its UX principles. Not the current `App/` code.
 - **Gap**: `same` · `ported with changes` (same feature, different details, no visible UX change) · `UX change` (user-visible difference) · `new` (not in legacy) · `dropped` (removed on purpose by a spec) · `not planned` (legacy feature no lot covers).
 - **Source**: `port: ezzz Swift layer` (the behaviour comes from `HFRswift/Swift`) · `port: legacy ObjC` · `new UX: operator` · `new UX: Bybifok (FEAT-xxx)` · `new UX: spec` (a lot spec decided it) · `—` (not planned).
+- **H.1** (convergence classification, directive H.1):
+  - `a`: a port of ezzz's Swift layer at `2440d79`, or of the ObjC app where the Swift layer had nothing. Technical changes only (new engine, iOS 27 APIs, robustness, added themes with unchanged defaults).
+  - `a·master`: a port of ezzz's later Swift layer on `master`, absent at `2440d79` (UXD-01).
+  - `b`: a UX evolution, proposed for M5 ([#379](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/379)) unless a pending decision keeps it.
+  - `b·needed`: an evolution that parity needs (security, privacy, App Review, an HFR fact).
+  - `b·operator`: an evolution the operator already decided.
+  - `—`: not planned or dropped.
+  - The open choices are in [UX-DECISIONS-PENDING.md](UX-DECISIONS-PENDING.md).
 - Row ids `GAP-NNN` are stable: a later revision edits a row in place or appends a new id, never renumbers. Rows were extracted per area by Sonnet sub-agents and merged; duplicates across areas keep one row. A second Sonnet agent checked a sample of 20 legacy citations: 10 exact, 9 imprecise ranges and 1 wrong (all 10 corrected). Expect line ranges elsewhere to be approximate: check a ref before quoting it in a spec.
